blocks.title: Cookie management
blocks.text: Cookie management ka matlab tay karna hai ke kaunsi cookies rakhni aur kaunsi mitani hain.
Pasandeeda shopping site ki cookies rakhein ta ke login rahein, magar privacy bachane ke liye doosri sites ki cookies mitayein.

blocks.prompt: Cookies kahan manage ho sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: Browser ki privacy ya cookie settings mein, aur site ke cookie-consent banner par.

items: Cookies manage karein: mufeed rakhein, peecha karne wali mitayein.
